description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 
 Job Title: Lead Software Engineer (Computational Aeroelasticity) 
   
 Location: Nottingham or London, United Kingdom 
                                                 
 Reports to: Software Engineering Manager 
   
   
 Job Overview 
 Join Cadence to develop advanced aeroelastic analysis capabilities for our commercial engineering software. This role brings together aeroelasticity, structural dynamics and scientific software development. You will translate engineering methods into robust, practical simulation tools. 
   
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Develop and validate methods for aeroelastic analysis, including flutter, gust response, and aerodynamic-structural coupling.
 Implement numerical methods in production-quality scientific software.
 Apply finite element models, modal methods, and structural dynamics formulations to aeroelastic problems.
 Develop automated tests and take part in software verification and validation.
 Collaborate with aerospace engineers and software development teams.
   
 Job Qualifications: 
 To succeed in this role, you will bring: 
 MSc, Ph.D., or equivalent experience in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Computational Engineering, or a related field.
 Strong foundation in aeroelasticity and structural dynamics.
 Experience developing scientific or engineering software using C++, Fortran, Python, or a similar programming language.
   
 Additional Skills/Preferences:                      
 Experience in one or more of the following is beneficial but not required: 
 Flutter, gust response, aeroservoelasticity, or dynamic aeroelasticity.
 Panel methods, Doublet Lattice Method (DLM), Vortex Lattice Method (VLM), or generalized aerodynamic forces.
 Finite element methods, modal analysis, vibration, or dynamic response.
 Reduced-order modeling, nonlinear aeroelasticity, or aerothermoelasticity.
 Aerospace simulation tools such as MSC Nastran, ZAERO, Abaqus, or equivalent.
   
 Additional Information: 
 Team: you will collaborate with aerospace engineers and software development teams.
 Languages and tools: C++, Fortran, Python or similar, plus the simulation tools
   
 Check what we can offer you: 
 Competitive salary 
 25 days holiday per year 
 Private Medical and Dental plans, Income Protection and Life Insurance 
 Group Personal Pension Plan 
 Cycle to work scheme and gym subsidy 
 5 days paid time to volunteer to give back to our communities 
 Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
 The opportunity to work for a Great Place to Work© & Fortune 100 organization 
   
 Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace.  
 We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.
